title: Dying Woman Seeks Home For Dogs
main_content:
Americans definitely love their dogs.

But what happens when dogs outlive their owners?

That is going to happen to Kathleen Zuidema, a dog-lover from the U.S. state of Washington.

Zuidema has lung cancer and does not expect to live much longer.

She has three dogs, Australian shepherds.

Zuidema is making plans for the end of her life, and she wrote this post on Facebook in March:

“My heart is breaking and I’m sobbing as I write this...”

Zuidema said she needs someone to take all three dogs, and not break them up.

But Zuidema lives on a small island in the cold waters off the coast of Washington state. There are few people who would be able to take in three dogs together.

For about three weeks, Zuidema’s post was passed from person to person. It was shared more than 30,000 times.

Another islander, Danielle Cochran, walked over to Zuidema’s home and asked if she could help. She did not know Zuidema.

Zuidema’s last wishes will not go unanswered.

questions.question: Why was Kathleen Zuidema searching for a new home for her dogs?
options: She was planning to move to a different state.
She can no longer take care of them due to her illness.
She found a new job that doesn't allow pets.
Her dogs needed training that she couldn't provide.
questions.answer: She can no longer take care of them due to her illness.

questions.question: Where did Zuidema write her post?
options: In a local newspaper to reach more residents.
On Facebook to connect with friends and family.
On a community bulletin board on the island.
questions.answer: On Facebook to connect with friends and family.

questions.question: Who decided to take the dogs?
options: A local animal shelter that heard about the situation.
A friend of Zuidema who saw the post.
An islander named Danielle Cochran who volunteered.
A family member looking to adopt them.
questions.answer: An islander named Danielle Cochran who volunteered.
